_comment: M2 unit-test fixtures: raw candidate ideas before scoring. Cases: clean pass candidate; missing viewer; unrepayable hook; unfilmable payoff; unsupported number claim.

candidates.hook_overlay: If someone says these 3 phrases, walk away.
candidates.target_viewer: 18-34 viewers interested in relationships and self-protection
candidates.payoff: Viewer learns the 3 phrases, the bias each exploits, and the counter-sentence.

candidates.hook_overlay: This will change your life forever!!!
candidates.payoff: Explains expense ratios with one concrete example.

candidates.topic: what a black hole feels like from inside
candidates.payoff: Abstract speculation with no visual demonstration possible.
Explains what the liver actually does.
